00043 DustUGenInternal::DustUGenInternal(Dust_InputsWithTypesOnly) throw()
00044 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00045     random((unsigned int)this * 823487UL + 18493UL ),
00046     prevDensity(0.f),
00047     threshold(0.f),
00048     scale(0.f)

00050     inputs[Density] = density;

00058 void DustUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00059 {
00060     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00061     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00062     float currentDensity = *(inputs[Density].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00063     
00064     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00065     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00066     
00067     if (currentDensity != prevDensity) {
00068         threshold = currentDensity * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00069         scale  = threshold > 0.f ? 1.f / threshold : 0.f;
00070     }
00071     
00072     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00073     {
00074         float value = Ran088::nextFloat(s1, s2, s3);
00075         if(value < threshold)
00076             *outputSamples++ = value * scale;
00077         else
00078             *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00079     }
00080     
00081     prevDensity = currentDensity;
00082     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00083 }

00095 void Dust2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
